checked.how: Traced: `at` outside [0,1) and |lateral| > width/2−1 fail with messages naming `pickups[i].at` / `.lateral`; key absent → `...(pickups && {pickups})` omits it; layout.pickups = [] without data. dust-bowl.json has 6 pickups (width 11 → bound 4.5, laterals ±3.5 OK); bramble/hay-loop untouched in diff.

checked.target: Dust Bowl pickup placement vs straights and ramp run-out
checked.how: Summed centreline segments (~399 units): at 0.04 ≈ 16 u on the top straight before the ramp at 0.09 (lip ~41 u, run-out to ~66 u); at 0.47 ≈ 187 u on the bottom straight between (50,-31.2) and (25.2,-31.2). Lateral sign uses same cos/sin(heading) offset as propRows.

checked.target: AC2/AC3 collect and respawn (src/sim/pickups.ts, world.ts stepWorld/raceView)
checked.how: collectPickups only for car 0 at end of tick, returns early if armed (no stacking); respawn=300 set at tick T, decremented at start of each later tick → entry false in exactly 300 views. raceView adds armed/boostTicks only when world.pickups exists, armed only for i===0. No collider for pickups, so collecting alone doesn't touch CarState.

Fire sets boostTicks=90 after decrement, so the view reads 90 then counts down; boosted while >0 → 90 boosted ticks, topSpeed 32 on dirt. action while unarmed: beginPickupTick changes nothing and boosting false → stepCars(boosted=-1) identical.
createPickups([]) → undefined; stepWorld guards `pickups !== undefined`, so action is ignored; raceView adds no pickups/armed/boostTicks keys.

encode ORs FLAG_ACTION=4; decode defines `action` (non-enumerable, value true) only when bit set, so `'action' in` is false when clear; runReplay passes decoded frames straight to stepWorld which reads inputs[0]?.action. Grep found no spread/copy of decoded frames anywhere.

Space keydown preventDefaults, adds to `down` and latches actionTapped; keyup deletes; actionPressed clears latch each read. Touch grab('action') latches too. read() only sets input.action when either is true; gamepad has no action.

race-ui calls setAction(me?.armed ?? null) each sync: null → no slot, ids stay 4; false → button 'Boost' with bolt icon appended, aria-disabled=true; false→true adds is-popping (kept through the wake re-show, removed after release ms) and only on that transition. CSS slot centred over GAS with --touch-action 64px (token exists).

setPowerUp inserts SPACE·POWER-UP before PAUSE only when view.pickups defined; screenshot 1440x900 pickups--armed shows STEER, GAS, BRAKE, SPACE POWER-UP, ESC PAUSE; 844x390 shows mustard bolt roundel above GAS. scene.ts builds 'pickups' group, one mesh per layout pickup, visibility from game.ts draw() passing view.pickups.

TRACKS sorted by file name: bramble-bends, dust-bowl, hay-loop, so RACE → Bramble (no button), NEXT RACE → Dust Bowl. Wake at GO makes the action button active (dirt fill) for 4 s; first box row ~16 u past the line is reached in that window, collect pop + wake → mustard. 90 ticks = 1.5 s boost, 300 ticks = 5 s respawn. Legend shows on desktop during lap 1.
